closing: That is the briefing for now.

topics.title: Physicists report a possible fusion shortcut
topics.summary: Researchers at Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory reported a model suggesting that heating plasma before compression could reduce the energy needed for fusion ignition. The work also says tungsten contamination can sharply raise the pressure needed for ignition.
topics.detail: The model adds four plasma effects and points to a lower-energy route the authors call a Cordey saddle. The researchers said the approach updates the Lawson criterion with synchrotron radiation, impurities and heat loss. They also said coating reactor interiors with liquid lithium could help limit tungsten contamination.

sources.title: Scientists may have found a shortcut to fusion energy

topics.title: US permit push meets fresh deep-sea mining warnings
topics.summary: The Trump administration signaled it is nearing approval for deep-sea mining permits, according to reports on Sunday. Separate coverage said scientists found a trial in the South China Sea rapidly disrupted seafloor microbes tied to nutrient cycling.
topics.detail: One report said Interior Secretary Doug Burgum announced plans to issue deep-sea mining permits within months as part of a push to expand critical mineral supply chains. Another report said a new paper from scientists at the Chinese Academy of Sciences describes rapid ecosystem disruption after a mining trial at about 1,300 meters deep. The same report said public comment on a US review process remains open until October 19.

topics.title: Quantum firms press ahead with funding and benchmarks
topics.summary: Recent quantum computing coverage highlighted major funding rounds and new benchmarking progress. Reports said DARPA advanced four more companies to the final verification phase of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, while other firms announced large financing rounds and hardware milestones.
topics.detail: The reports said Atom Computing, Diraq, IBM and IonQ advanced to Stage C of the DARPA program. Coverage also said Oratomic closed a $475 million Series B, Universal Quantum raised more than $100 million, and IonQ reported a memory-enhanced photonic interconnect demonstration. Another item said Gartner projects global quantum computing revenue to reach $1.1 billion in 2027.
